# Quill

> Go off on a tangent. We’ll keep the thread.

Quill is a mobile AI note-taking app in closed beta, for students, researchers,
writers, and professionals who think out loud. Voice, text, and PDFs become
clean, titled notes and flashcards for review.

## Product

- Speak freely: voice recordings become a title, summary, key points, and next steps.
- Type or import a PDF: collect ideas in the same quiet place.
- Recall: built-in flashcards help you revisit key ideas.

## Access

- Join with your name, email, one or more roles, optional referral source, and explicit early-access contact consent.
- The hero email field carries your address into the full form; it does not create an entry by itself.
- No account required. No unrelated marketing. Duplicate emails are handled.
- Illustrative website demos do not record audio or run live AI.
- Local demo mode is explicitly labelled and does not send invitation emails.
- Contact: helloasharaamer@gmail.com
